ValidationRule.description: Invoice must be set for notice types that are issued against a specific invoice (Rent Reminder, Rent Arrears).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK(Invoice__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(Notice_Type__c, "Rent Reminder"), ISPICKVAL(Notice_Type__c, "Rent Arrears") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invoice is required when the Notice Type is "Rent Reminder" or "Rent Arrears".
